name: clipboard
description: Clipboard runes for Claude Code: clip (ask about what you copied), clip-copy (clean deliverable from Claude's output onto the clipboard), clip-ocr (text out of a clipboard image, back onto the clipboard), clip-edit (transform and write back), clip-save (save to disk), clip-history (durable typed recall), clip-snippet (named text/image snippet library). Built-in secret detection: credentials are flagged and never stored.
